title: 领益智造董事长：AIDC电源和散热是重点，已获多家客户样品
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: You are looking to comment your tactics to capacity expansion beyond the human role robot factory. Where else are you putting money into?
segments.zh: 除了人形机器人，你还把钱投到哪里？

segments.en: AIDC, must be the first one.
So we already have a hyper power charger and then for the ACDC to DC to DC to DC, so all this kind of power module is going to be a big area for us to invest.
segments.zh: 我们已有超级电源充电器，从AC到DC的各种电源模块将是重点。

segments.en: We are actually doing a quite more than eight different customer for making samples.
segments.zh: 我们正在为超过8家客户制作样品。

segments.en: But the power for AIDC is really needs more than one year to do the verification.
segments.zh: 但AIDC电源需要一年以上验证。

segments.en: So that big time and then two is our thermal solution.
segments.zh: 所以耗时很长，第二是散热方案。

segments.en: So the thermal one, which is a higher rear door.
segments.zh: 散热方面，我们有高效后门散热。

segments.en: So we are going to, that's their media's approved supplier.
segments.zh: 我们已成为其媒体认可的供应商。

segments.en: So we are going to use that to bring all different production lines into the top customer.
segments.zh: 我们将以此将不同生产线引入顶级客户。

segments.en: And then we also involved with other components or things for the AIDC.
segments.zh: 我们还参与AIDC的其他组件。

segments.en: Are you seeing any components shortage in all the sectors you are present in right now?
segments.zh: 你现在所在的领域有组件短缺吗？
